title: ebay | How To | I haven't received my item on eBay
description: As a buyer on eBay, if you haven't received your item this video is intended to help. We will show you how to verify the estimated delivery date, how to reach out to your seller and if needs be, open up a case. eBay YouTube Customer Support Hours are Monday – Friday, 6:00AM – 6:00PM PST. For help outside these hours, please contact eBay Customer Service at http://ebay.to/2elcv5C

asr.full_text: Hey! I'm Kim, I work for eBay's customer service, and today I'd like to talk to you about when you purchase an item on ebay and it never arrives. Most of the time, your transactions will go through smoothly. This is for one of the rare circumstances that something may go wrong. So the first thing you want to do if you believe your item is going to be late is check your estimated delivery date. To check the estimated delivery date hover over My eBay and click on purchase history. Find the item in question and to the right of item, you'll see the estimated delivery date. If the date hasn't passed, then the item may still be in transit. If the tracking details have been provided and the item is being sent through a recognized carrier such as UPS, FedEx, or USPS, you will also be able to see the tracking number as well as additional tracking details by clicking on the tracking number. If the item is beyond the delivery date, the next thing that you want to do is to verify that your shipping address is correct. To do this, find the item in question and on the right hand side click View Order Details. On the right hand side of the order details screen you can see and verify your shipping address if there is a problem with the address you provided it is important to reach out to your seller and let them know what's going on to ensure the best resolution your seller does want to ensure that your transaction on eBay go as smoothly as possible to contact your seller go back to the item in question and click on more actions and then click on contact seller From here you'll have a few options You can first contact the seller by selecting the first option that says I have a question about using my item or I want to send the seller a message and click on contact seller if the item is beyond the delivery date and you haven't received your items you can let the seller know by opening a request to open a request select I didn't receive my item from here will confirm the estimated delivery date and shipping details you can open your request by clicking the link that says request a refund or more information. On the following screen, you can select how you would like your seller to try and resolve the situation by selecting either, I want a refund or I want the item. You can then add a custom message to the request to let your seller know any additional details, then select send request. Once you've opened a request this seller has four business days to resolve it. If you're not satisfied with the resolution the seller provides you can ask eBay to step in. If you've asked eBay to step in we will review your request to see if it qualifies for a eBay Money-back guarantee and get back with you within two business days. I personally love the eBay Money-back guarantee because it makes me feel very safe purchasing on the website. I hope this video is helpful and have a great day.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it provides customer-support guidance for an eBay buyer who has not received an item, including checking the estimated delivery date and contacting the seller. It concerns an existing purchase dispute and suggests requesting a refund or the item and escalating to eBay, rather than soliciting an investment, payment, credentials, or other participation from viewers. The described material supports an ordinary support and dispute-resolution context, although the operation or outcome of any external service is not independently established.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central subject is an ordinary eBay commerce and customer-support service: resolving a missing-item purchase through delivery checking, seller contact, and a buyer request.
